sum: WISeSat.Space Holdings Corp. is a space technology company focused on secure satellite communications for internet of things applications in Switzerland. It has a strategic collaboration with Kaynes Space Technology Private Limited to develop post-quantum security solutions for satellites manufactured in India. The company is headquartered in Road Town, the British Virgin Islands. WISeSat.Space Holdings Corp. operates as a subsidiary of WISeKey International Holding AG.
ceo: Mr. Carlos Creus Moreira (Founder, Chairman & CEO)
